meta.title: sk_pqc Component Map
meta.subtitle: One hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 wire format, three implementations, secure if either leg holds

boundaries.label: Three sk_pqc implementations, same wire format

cards.title: Experimental and unaudited
items: No third-party security audit, fuzzing, or formal review yet
Binds vetted primitive libraries: liboqs, noble-post-quantum, pyca cryptography
The only original crypto is the HKDF-SHA256 combiner

cards.title: Secure if either leg holds
items: HKDF-SHA256(X25519_ss concatenated with ML-KEM-768_ss), concatenate-then-KDF, never XOR, never pure-PQ
A break of either leg alone still leaves the other
Never call this quantum-proof, quantum-safe, or unbreakable

cards.title: One core, many bindings
items: Direction: one audited pure-Rust core, surfaced to other languages over FFI
Python binding (PyO3) is proven and cross-parity tested both directions
Dart binding (flutter_rust_bridge) is in progress; today's Dart ratchet is a thin, clearly marked bridge pinned to the same test vectors
